newsitem.title: USA: National Surgery files for share offering.
newsitem.headline: National Surgery files for share offering.

text.p: National Surgery Centers Inc said Friday it filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission a proposed offering of 2.75 million of its common shares.

Of the total, 2,003,011 are being offered by the company and nearly 746,989 by selling shareholders. The company said National Surgery management would not sell any shares in the offering. The company said it will grant an over-allotment option of up to an additional 412,500 shares.
Alex, Brown & Sons Inc, Furman Selz Inc and J.P. Morgan Securities Inc will manage the offering.
The company said it intends to use the proceeds for general corporate purposes, including possible future acquisitions and development.
